description: Election Commission - Declare that Rathnayake Mudiyanselage Bandula Rathnayake was Selected as the Member of the Rideegama P/S
reasoning: This gazette notice concerns the filling of a vacancy for a member of a local authority (Rideegama Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. The content specifically deals with the electoral process for a local government body, including the declaration of a selected member to fill a vacancy caused by resignation, which falls under the Elections category (Type 7).
